name: scale
description: F7 (SPEC section 3, S7): a generated tallykit-like package of M independent modules (one small pure function each) for N = M / 2 agents, two modules per ticket, plus the same shared registry (scalekit/__init__.py) and CHANGELOG.md as F1 that every ticket touches, so the chance of a real merge conflict grows with N. gen.py writes the template, the tasks and the reference from a seed; the hidden checker is checks/scale.

n2.note: a two-agent smoke size for tests and a first look; not a size of scenario S7
